review_type: AI editorial review of twelve A2 Spreken tasks (three video-answer, three picture-describe, three picture-choose, three picture-sequence) and their sentence starters: prompt shape per official type, cue naturalness and register, image briefs against the house style and the pair and sequence rules, cast traits verbatim, criteria that mirror the type, sample quotes and learner errors, model coverage and A2 level, level verdict per task, diversity against the catalogue and batch 026, media notes; repairs applied in the proposed file
reviewer_context: fresh; the author's notes and doubts were read after every task had been judged
verdict_summary: All twelve tasks pass in the proposed file after two required picture-brief repairs: the bakkerij pair now shows Julio at the oven in both pictures and differs only in the time of day (pair rule), and sollicitatiegesprek panel 1 replaces a handwritten letter (a text object) with a laptop with a blank screen. Six changed lines in total; criteria, samples, quotes, models and starters are byte-identical to the author's files, so the author's starters file stands at its hash. No item rejected. Checker on the proposed file: no failures, no warnings.

edits.new: In a bakery early in the morning, Julio (young man, curly hair, striped shirt) wears an apron and slides a tray of bread rolls into a large oven; through the window the sky is pale pink and orange with the sun rising. No text.
edits.why: The pair must differ only in the thing the task asks about (early morning or evening); the dawn sky is the morning cue and contrasts with the night sky of picture 2.

edits.new: Een jonge man schuift 's ochtends vroeg een bakplaat met broodjes in de oven van een bakkerij; door het raam komt de zon op.
edits.why: Describes the picture with its time cue; 'bakplaat met broodjes' replaces 'plaat brood'.

edits.new: In the same bakery in the evening, Julio (young man, curly hair, striped shirt) wears the same apron and slides a tray of bread rolls into the same large oven; through the window the sky is dark blue with a crescent moon and a few stars. No text.
edits.why: config/illustration.json pairRule: the options differ in the one thing asked and match in everything else; the author's evening picture (sweeping beside an empty counter) differed in the job as well as the time.

edits.new: Een jonge man schuift 's avonds een bakplaat met broodjes in de oven van een bakkerij; door het raam is de maan te zien.
edits.why: Matches the new picture; neutral between the options.

edits.new: At a kitchen table at home, Sabrina (woman in her thirties, long dark hair, green jumper) sits at a laptop and types, looking at the screen. No text, blank laptop screen.
edits.why: A handwritten letter is lines of text, which the 'No text' checklist cannot honour (the 009 ochtenddienst calendar decision); a blank laptop screen is the bank's convention (009 ochtenddienst, 026 lunchpauze, 026 online-winkel) and matches how applications are sent. Model ('schrijft ... een sollicitatiebrief') and starter unchanged.

edits.new: Een vrouw zit thuis aan tafel en typt op een laptop.
edits.why: Describes the new panel without revealing a key.

The learner invents the routine as in 009 bushalte. Display note of the 009 level check applies (app).

A2:speaking:batch027-bakkerij:1.evidence: Official choose pattern; after E1 the pair shows Julio at the oven in both pictures and differs only in the window (sunrise vs crescent moon). Sample chooses the morning with a reason and ignores the other picture, null 3; model 43 words chooses the evening, gives reasons, mentions the first picture; both remain true of the new pictures. A2:speaking:batch027-contant-pinnen:1.evidence: Same counter, shopkeeper (three traits) and bag; only the payment differs; blank banknote and terminal. Panels 1 and 3 need a small inference the prompt supports.

diversity_review: Twelve distinct settings and acts; Fatima and Karim twice, others once; the two health tasks and the two shop tasks are of different types; new cells against 009: choose × winkels-diensten, sequence × werk / wonen-buurt / gezondheid; needed-list coverage: sick leave, a course choice, huisarts, tandarts, OV, paying and the checkout, a job application. Near pairs and decisions: bakkerij vs 009 ochtenddienst (same preference, not in one form); keuken vs 026 koken-buurvrouw (Fatima at a stove, different type and act, not in one set); ziekmelden vs 026 lunchpauze (Roos as colleague with 'Hé' in both stills, different acts, not in one video drill; Sabrina f-adult is a drop-in if distinct speakers are wanted); bus-fiets vs 009 trein-auto and 026 fiets-lopen (three mode pairs; bus-fiets and fiets-lopen not in one form); taalcafe-oefenen vs 022 taalcafé (listening) and 026 woorden-leren (different parts and acts); wachtkamer and tandartsbezoek vs receptive huisarts and tandarts items; sollicitatiegesprek vs B1 017 trein-gemist; verhuizen vs KNM verhuizing and 009 nieuwe-buurvrouw. The adopted 026 review lists five more cross-batch neighbours of different types (huisarts-afspraak / wachtkamer, marktkraam / kassa, regen / bus-fiets, online-winkel / contant-pinnen, bibliotheekboek / taalcafe-oefenen): out of one drill of four, and out of one mock form when the same type.
set_assembly: 026 (adopted; fiets-lopen relabelled vervoer, bibliotheekboek winkels-diensten) + 027 give six per type: one mock form with no item shared with the 009 form plus a half form. Proposed form (four cue voices, no cast name in consecutive tasks, every same-type neighbour pair of this review and of the 026 review kept apart): video ziekmelden, woorden-leren, huisarts-afspraak, cursuskeuze; describe wachtkamer, regen, keuken, kassa; choose bakkerij, online-winkel, bus-fiets, feest-thuis; sequence sollicitatiegesprek, bibliotheekboek, tandartsbezoek, treinkaartje. Half form: lunchpauze, taalcafe-oefenen / marktkraam, schoolplein / fiets-lopen, contant-pinnen / koken-buurvrouw, verhuizen. Karim appears three times in the mock, never consecutively. Neither batch has an instanties task; the 026 review's drill plan adds 009 brief-gemeente to a sequence drill, and the two plans are compatible. Drill order within 027, easiest first: video taalcafe-oefenen, cursuskeuze, ziekmelden; describe kassa, keuken, wachtkamer; choose bus-fiets, bakkerij, contant-pinnen; sequence verhuizen, tandartsbezoek, sollicitatiegesprek.
media_notes: Audio: 12 prompt clips (narrator, Serge de Beer) and 3 cue clips, about 1,850 characters; cue voices ziekmelden Roos→f-young (Roos; 'Hé' may transcribe as 'Hee'; quiet voice, normalisation applies), taalcafe-oefenen Meneer De Vries→m-older (Arjen, as in 009 bushalte; colon reads as a pause), cursuskeuze de adviseur→m-adult (Robert, first A2 cue). No digits. Illustrations: 21 images (3 stills, 3 singles 816×816, 6 pair, 9 panels at 1024×640). Risks: banknote, coins and terminal (contant-pinnen); milk carton recognisability (kassa); book spines (verhuizen panel 1, taalcafe library); blank laptop screen (sollicitatiegesprek panel 1); blank card (tandartsbezoek panel 3); van without logos; bus without a sign; phone screens; the bakkerij time cue (sunrise vs crescent moon) must read at display size; small details (coins, mirror and gloves, blocks and cup, stars); consistency of the interviewer, the dentist, the shopkeeper, the bag, the apron; Fatima's coat and Hasan's cap indoors are cast traits, check they read as garments; wachtkamer has four figures, redo without the mother if it artefacts. Alt texts ready.
coordinator_notes: Adopt with npm run batch:adopt 027 (source_sha256 = proposed bytes; starters hash = the author's file, no proposed starters). Then media, then npm run content:integrate (starters merge with the review). The author's notes §4 and doubts 5–6 describe the superseded bakkerij and letter pictures. Config suggestions outside this review: record the implied family links (Hasan and Fatima; Roos, Sem, Amina) in the cast note, and consider a Fatima garment that works indoors. The 009 level-check recommendation to hide criteria before speaking for video-answer stands.
limitations: AI editorial review; no educator review, learner trial, blueprint validation or psychometric calibration; no official equivalence. Level judged against the official task descriptions and the calibrated 009 tasks, not stored exemplars (content/exemplars/ does not exist) or learner data; targetLevelValidated stays false. Text fields, cues and briefs only; generated pictures, clips and feedback prompts need their own review after media production. The two edited briefs are the reviewer's wording without a second reading beyond the coordinator's diff.
